audit_entry.title: Harden path validation and improve error handling consistency
audit_entry.description: Enhanced is_safe_path function with realpath resolution to prevent TOCTOU attacks and symlink traversal, plus improved error handling consistency.

security_issues_addressed.impact: Potential unauthorized file access via symlink attacks
security_issues_addressed.mitigation: Use realpath to resolve canonical paths before validation

security_issues_addressed.issue: Path traversal via symlinks not prevented
security_issues_addressed.impact: Potential escape from allowed directories through crafted symlinks
security_issues_addressed.mitigation: Resolve both target and allowed directory paths with realpath

security_issues_addressed.issue: Inconsistent error severity handling across modules
security_issues_addressed.impact: Confusing error reporting and inconsistent logging
security_issues_addressed.mitigation: Added severity validation and normalization functions

changes: Enhanced is_safe_path() with realpath resolution for TOCTOU prevention
Added comprehensive directory resolution using realpath for both target and allowed paths
Expanded allowed directories to include XDG_DATA_HOME and common user directories
Added validate_severity() function for consistent error level handling
Added handle_error_ex() for enhanced error reporting with context and notifications
Improved logging with warning messages for path resolution failures

security_improvements.description: Use realpath -m to resolve canonical paths preventing race conditions between validation and usage
Both target paths and allowed directory paths resolved to prevent symlink-based bypasses
Extended allowed directories to include XDG directories and common user folders
Falls back to original path if realpath fails, with appropriate logging
Added contextual error reporting and desktop notifications for critical errors

path_validation_enhancements: TOCTOU prevention through consistent path resolution
Extended allowed directories for user convenience
Detailed warning logs for security violations
testing_notes: Test path traversal attempts with ../ patterns
Test realpath failure handling with non-existent intermediate directories
Verify allowed directory access still works correctly
Test error severity validation and normalization
Test desktop notification functionality for critical errors

backward_compatibility.breaking_changes: None - existing valid paths continue to work
behavioral_changes: Stricter symlink handling may reject previously accepted edge cases
Additional warning logs for security validation failures

concerns: realpath may behave differently on various systems
Performance impact of path resolution on high-frequency operations
mitigations: Fallback to original path if realpath fails
Path validation typically used infrequently (file operations)

metadata.estimated_impact: High - prevents several classes of file system security vulnerabilities
